newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-INDIA, TAIWAN GDRS SLIP IN THIN TRADE.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-INDIA, TAIWAN GDRS SLIP IN THIN TRADE.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts retraced on Wednesday in low volumes while Taiwan GDRs fell back after a nervous session in the home market.
Bombay stocks had ended sharply lower ahead of a government meeting to discuss possible oil price increases, with the main index down 54.90 at 4,370.13.
But in recent days the GDR and local markets have been moving out of synch, dealers noted.
"The GDRs seem to have detached themselves from the local market for the time being," said one, adding GDR prices were being driven by their own supply and demand in thin dealings.
The HSBC James Capel India GDR index lost 1.14 points, or 1.32 percent, to 85.36, a premium of 18.51 percent to the local market.
The Cazenove Indian GDR index, which measures changes from midday to midday, was down 0.58 points at 96.88.
The Capel Taiwan index was off 2.88 points, or 2.10 percent, at 134.64 -- representing a discount of 3.24 percent -- as the local market continued its retreat.
The Capel Korea index finished down 0.82 points, or 1.06 percent, at 76.91, a premium of 37.08 percent.
